verdict.summary: The new Solid MCP aggregate tools consistently derive their data from PodStore::view_for(Read) via a GRAPH-variable CONSTRUCT, preserving the same named-graph authorization boundary as session-scoped queries and an empty default graph. The tests exercise the load-bearing security invariant with disjoint principals, distinct private vocabulary, a grant-less session, public dispatch, and post-write freshness; widening the projection to the whole store would make those assertions fail. The projection is rebuilt per call and CONSTRUCT returns an RDF graph, so the documented merge/deduplication semantics match the implementation. Public tool metadata and the matching agent-tools skill are updated. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was present in the diff. There is a harmless duplicate listing of the three new specs in tool_spec_consts_serialize_with_schema, but it does not affect correctness or coverage enough to warrant a finding.
